title: Why Most Traders Are Getting This Market Wrong
speaker: Tom Preston (TP) and Chris Butler (tastylive)

macro_themes.view: S&P 1.5% off its high but 27 names at 52-week lows vs 4 highs and under half above the 200-day; indices hide damage.
With VIX ~14-16 near all-time highs, index premium is cheap: buy index puts/put spreads rather than sell index premium; sell single-name vol instead.

calls.reason: Narrow leadership and poor breadth; index premium too cheap to sell; Chris is short a little S&P, TP says it could test the downside.
calls.quote: Me, I am long VIX. I'm short a little S&Ps.

calls.reason: VIX at 14-16 with the index a few percent from highs and weak breadth makes index vol cheap.

notes: No air date stated; listing approx used. VIX quoted as '15, 16' and '13.82' earlier in the month. Mostly options-education Q&A (IV rank vs percentile, delta).
